description: Source code for an MD5 hashing driver utilizing hardware acceleration in the Linux kernel, part of the IFX UEIP project, specifically for the DEU module on MIPS architecture.

methods.name: md5_transform
methods.description: Main interface to hardware MD5 transformation, processes a 64-byte input block.

methods.name: md5_transform_helper
methods.description: Helper function to call md5_transform with current context.

methods.name: md5_update
methods.description: Processes input data on-the-fly for MD5 hashing.

methods.name: md5_final
methods.description: Computes the final MD5 hash value.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5
methods.description: Registers the MD5 driver with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5
methods.description: Unregisters the MD5 driver from the Linux crypto API.
